entities.summary: Alexandra ("Sandra") Johanna Le Poole is a retired field hockey player from the Netherlands. She was part of the Dutch hockey teams that won the 1984 Summer Olympics, world championships in 1978, 1979, 1983 and 1986, and European championships in 1984.
